text: Mumbai is a coastal metropolis and commercial and entertainment centre with colonial architecture, heritage sites, beaches, bazaars and museums.
Mumbai's guide highlights the Gateway of India, Elephanta Caves, the Victorian and Art Deco Ensemble, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Marine Drive, Juhu Beach and Girgaum Chowpatty.
Mumbai is served by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (BOM) and Mumbai Central Railway Station (MMCT), according to Incredible India.
Incredible India recommends October to February for visiting Mumbai, describing mild temperatures and breezy evenings during this period.
Incredible India describes street food as part of Mumbai's visitor experience and mentions food stalls at Juhu Beach and Girgaum Chowpatty.
General India travel guidance: respect local dress codes and customs, particularly when visiting religious sites and rural areas.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.
Nashik is a city on the Godavari River with religious sites, Sahyadri landscapes and vineyards. Incredible India describes it as a destination for spiritual visits and wine tourism.
Nashik highlights listed by Incredible India include Panchvati, Ramkund, Kalaram Temple, Trimbakeshwar Temple, Saptashrungi Devi Mandir and Sula Vineyards.

Incredible India lists Nasik Road Railway Station (NK) for Nashik. The same page's airport listing is inconsistent about the location of ISK, so confirm airport options directly before planning air travel.

Shirdi is a pilgrimage destination in Ahmednagar district associated with Sai Baba. Maharashtra Tourism describes the Sai Baba temple as the centre of this devotional site.
